chapter_title_en: The Gift of Scriptures and the Shadow of Loss
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 398 – The Gift of Scriptures and a Master’s Warning of Chaos
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning returns to the Black-White College, gifting a mountain of scriptures, only to learn of widespread chaos, assassination plots in Anchan City, and the disappearance of his junior brother Mu Northson.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 398 – A Hero’s Homecoming Turns Sour
og_description: Ji Ning shares the spoils of his journey with his beloved sect, but the news of a vanished friend and a rising storm darkens his triumphant return.
twitter_title: Desolate Era 398: Ji Ning’s Gift vs. A Friend’s Ghost
twitter_description: Ji Ning returns with priceless scriptures, only to learn his junior brother has vanished. The calm is over.

lore_anchors.definition: A superior Ki Refining technique that provides an unparalleled foundation for a cultivator's Dao, far surpassing ordinary Immortal-level techniques.
The oldest Loose Immortal of the Black-White College, known for his coarse appearance and long lifespan.
One of the eight great powers of the Anchan Commandery, recently revealed to be far more powerful than its surface strength, capable of stalemating the ruling Northmont clan.
A Celestial Immortal aligned with the Anchan Northmont clan, who fought the Blood God Church's leader to a standstill.
A cultivator who failed their Heavenly Tribulation but survived by abandoning their physical body, forced to endure increasingly powerful tribulations every 100,000 to 500,000 years.
The periodic life-and-death ordeals faced by cultivators below the Celestial Immortal stage; surviving them becomes progressively harder.
